AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: The sim has no add-to-room phase - creature creation *is* construction - so AfterAddedToRoom's effect is applied from __init__ (flail_knight.py:84-87). SHARED-FINDINGS section 2's shared verdict, copied: the game runs these from MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom via CombatManager.AfterCreatureAdded (CombatManager.cs:860-867) inside StartCombatInternal (CombatManager.cs:394-398), i.e. after every creature is on the board and before Hook.BeforeCombatStart (CombatManager.cs:403); the sim runs them at create_monsters (combat.py:241, re-verified 2026-08-04, was :134), before relics attach (combat.py:274, was :157-159), before belt potions register (bare filename, was :164-166), before the parity Niche HP roll (combat.py:266-269, was :152-153) and before hooks.on_combat_start (combat.py:356, was :208). Same observable today on all three of section 2's clauses (listener set / HP-roll inversion / roll ordering); executed for this unit by `py audit/tools/monster_probes_b05.py rocket-ctor`, which prints the listener set at monster-construction time for a two-monster hive encounter: ['CombatHistory','StrikeCard','DefendCard', the previously-created monster's own powers] - no relic, no potion. Rule 7: the rationale leans on sts2_rl/combat.py, sts2_rl/relics/ruined_helmet.py, sts2_rl/relics/unsettling_lamp.py and src/Core/Combat/CombatManager.cs, which this record does NOT hash. Amounts and ORDER match: MysteriousKnight.cs:13-14 applies StrengthPower 6m then PlatingPower 6m, both self-applied; the sim applies them in the same order. The base call at :12 reaches MonsterModel.AfterAddedToRoom, which FlailKnight does not override, so there is no inherited effect to lose.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.issue: Closed 2026-07-28: monster_state_machine G1's misread is gone at this site. the inherited FlailKnight.build_machine (flail_knight.py:53-58) now reads FlailKnight.cs:50-51's AddBranch(moveState2, 2) / AddBranch(moveState3, 2) as RandomBranchState.AddBranch overload #9 (`int maxRepeats`, RandomBranchState.cs:105) -- repeat_type=CAN_REPEAT_X_TIMES with max_times=2 and add_branch's DEFAULT weight 1.0 -- instead of weight=2.0 with CAN_REPEAT_FOREVER. Verified by reading both sides this session -- MysteriousKnight (flail_knight.py:82-94) still overrides no move machine, so the corrected parent machine is what The Lantern Key's encounter now gets; `py audit/tools/state_machine_probes.py mismatch` now reports 'monsters whose sim port MISREADS the C# branch arguments: 0'.
